verdict.rationale: Neon publishes a documented public REST API (neon-docs-20/38) backed by a live OpenAPI spec (neon-probe-3), plus an llms.txt and docs.md tailored for AI agents (neon-probe-1, neon-probe-2), enabling programmatic control of projects, branches, etc. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of API usage beyond probes and richer coverage of API scopes/rate limits.
